pages.title: A Faint Breath
pages.text: A dragon's body is unlike a human's. When gravely hurt, it can slow its breathing and conserve energy through a long recovery.$(br2)As long as it has the will to live, it will not easily give up. Perhaps it is waiting for you to take it home.

pages.title: Feeding and Recovery
pages.text: Offer suitable meat or ordinary dragon meal to help it heal. Even at zero health, fire, ice, and lightning dragons in either form can still be saved.$(br2)Growth pauses during recovery. Food and time slowly restore health; keep the surroundings safe so it can rest.

pages.title: Meal and Horn Limits
pages.text: Ordinary dragon meal heals rather than grows an injured dragon; sickly meal is refused.$(br2)Horns cannot store injured dragons. Use a matching crystal: $(l:dragonmaid:care/items)Horns and Crystals$(/l).

pages.title: Protecting the Injured
pages.text: Clear nearby threats first. With empty hands, Shift-right-click to inspect your companion's health and condition. Enemies can take away newly restored health, so protect it from attacks.$(br2)Until fully healed, it remains severely injured. Keep feeding it and give it time.

pages.title: Commands After Recovery
pages.text: At full health, your companion sits up and waits for you to decide what comes next.$(br2)In human form, right-click with empty hands; in dragon form, use a dragon staff.$(br2)Recovery does not require $(l:dragonmaid:care/execution)mercy killing$(/l), an irreversible farewell.

pages.title: Reversing Petrification
pages.text: Use a Petrification Remedy on an intact owned dragon statue, or an untamed, ownerless human-form dragon statue. Either form can return.

pages.title: What Recovery Preserves
pages.text: After the stone shell falls away, owner, growth, knowledge, equipment, accessories, and inventory are retained.$(br2)The remedy does not heal existing injuries. If the dragon was severely injured, keep caring for it. The remedy is consumed only on success.

pages.title: Making Room
pages.text: Clear a landing space before using the remedy; dragon form needs more room.$(br2)An owned dragon's statue cannot be broken with a pickaxe or carried away. Clear the area and use the remedy there.

pages.title: Remedy and Old Statues
pages.text: Brew a mundane potion with a Gorgon's head to obtain a Petrification Remedy. See $(l:dragonmaid:care/petrification_remedy)the remedy page$(/l) for the method.$(br2)Apply it directly to a statue; it cannot be drunk or thrown. Old statues made before this recovery method was added cannot currently be restored.
